idle.description: Friendly market stance variations with satchel and produce crate.

walk.description: Three-quarter-right walking cycle for market handoffs.

sell.description: Selling and trading actions with produce, coin tray, and ledger beads.

ready.description: Coin-ready poses presenting receipt bundles or coin tokens.

backstory: Pip Vale keeps the Market Stall from turning into a black box. Pip knows every crate by origin, every coin by receipt, and treats trade as a civic promise: surplus can move, but the town remembers who made it possible.

postProcessing: Copied GPT Image 2.0 source into the project as market-trader-v1.source.png.
Converted mint and near-white chroma background to alpha with ImageMagick.
Kept the sheet at the project-native 2048x2048 / 4x4 / 512px-cell sprite contract.

transparency.method: ImageMagick chroma-key conversion from GPT Image 2 opaque source
